title: Lifting cohomology classes to punctured neighborhoods
statement: Let T be a spectral space, Z a closed subset with compact open complement, A an abelian sheaf on T, and q a natural number. Let D be the punctured-neighborhood cohomology diagram and C its canonical restriction cocone [def-weil-pbc-punctured-neighborhood-cohomology-diagram]. Every class y in C.pt is the image C_N(x) of some class x in D_N for some compact open neighborhood N of Z.

proof.text: Use the stage-representation theorem for the explicitly constructed punctured restriction system on the inverse image of the given class under coefficientCohomologyColimitIso.

The constant-colimit comparison identifies the resulting map with projection pullback and composition on coefficients. The open-subspace comparison changes the stage class into ambient object cohomology and identifies its image with the specified cocone leg. Cancel the two comparison isomorphisms.

lean.statement: theorem puncturedNeighborhood_cohomology_class_lift {T : Type u} [TopologicalSpace T] [SpectralSpace T] (Z : Set T) (hZ : IsClosed Z) (hU : IsCompact Zᶜ) (A : CategoryTheory.Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology T) AddCommGrpCat.{u}) (q : ℕ) (y : (puncturedNeighborhoodCohomologyCocone Z hZ A q).pt) : ∃ (N : (compactOpenNeighborhoods Z)ᵒᵖ) (x : (puncturedNeighborhoodCohomologyDiagram Z hZ A q).obj N), ((puncturedNeighborhoodCohomologyCocone Z hZ A q).ι.app N).hom x = y
